after.label: Roadside assistance
after.value: 24 months roadside support; IONIQ 9 towing is at driver expense under the published weight limit
after.basis: Australian roadside assistance
after.comparisonBasis: Australian roadside assistance
after.scope: Hyundai IONIQ 9 Calligraphy AWD 7-seat 110.3 kWh
qualifications: The published IONIQ 9 minimum kerb mass already exceeds the roadside towing threshold before adding occupants or cargo. Confirm the current recovery arrangement and charges; do not assume free towing from general roadside marketing.

Initial cover starts at warranty commencement; participating dealer/direct Hyundai supply and plan terms apply. Rental buyers and taxis are excluded. Renewal runs 24 months from a scheduled service at a participating Hyundai dealer; lifetime support is conditional on continued qualifying servicing.

Out-of-charge support includes a tow to the nearest charging point, subject to policy limitations. The towing clause covers vehicles weighing less than 2,500 kg at breakdown; heavier vehicles or specialist equipment can incur driver-paid recovery. This restriction is material to IONIQ 9.

Accident, off-road rescue, motorsport and other exclusions apply; not every tyre, towing or onward-travel cost is free. The EV terms are headed 1 September 2025 but retain an olderApril 2024 information sentence; the version is retained as published.
Earlier IONIQ 5 epochs before V.3 are not automatically assigned the 24-month explicit IONIQ wording. Any such residual identity requires separate applicability review.

gradeReview.reason: Current EV-specific policy confirms 24 months initial cover and renewal. Its included-towing clause requires actual weight strictly below 2,500 kg; the IONIQ 9 specification has minimum kerb mass above that boundary, so towing at driver expense is explicit for this model.

qualifications: Starts at first registration. Standard private-use passenger coverage; commercial use at any time is limited to 5 years/130,000 km, whichever first. People-mover vans and commercial vans have distinct 160,000 km policies and are not represented by these passenger-SUV terms.

Eligible passenger vehicles first registered from 1 June 2025 can qualify for up to 7 years/unlimitedkm only with all required authorised Hyundai dealer servicing; extension is recorded separately. Previous registration/service/use history matters for residual advertised-new units.

HV battery is separately 8 years/160,000 km.12 V battery 24 months/40,000 km; keyless remote battery 6 months; paint application defects 12 months. Wear, misuse, modifications, excluded competition and other policy exclusions apply. Australian Consumer Law rights remain.

qualifications: Starts at first registration. Standard private-use passenger coverage; commercial use at any time is limited to 5 years/130,000 km, whichever first. People-mover vans and commercial vans have distinct 160,000 km policies and are not represented by these passenger-SUV terms.

Eligible passenger vehicles first registered from 1 June 2025 can qualify for up to 7 years/unlimitedkm only with all required authorised Hyundai dealer servicing; extension is recorded separately. Previous registration/service/use history matters for residual advertised-new units.

HV battery is separately 8 years/160,000 km.12 V battery 24 months/40,000 km; keyless remote battery 6 months; paint application defects 12 months. Wear, misuse, modifications, excluded competition and other policy exclusions apply. Australian Consumer Law rights remain.
Official N-specific track-day FAQ separately allows non-competitive Track Day use; it does not remove racing/rallying/competition/timed-event exclusions.

Eligible passenger vehicles first registered from 1 June 2025 can qualify for up to 7 years/unlimitedkm only with all required authorised Hyundai dealer servicing; extension is recorded separately. Previous registration/service/use history matters for residual advertised-new units.

Renewal runs 24 months from a scheduled service at a participating Hyundai dealer; lifetime support is conditional on continued qualifying servicing.

Accident, off-road rescue, motorsport and other exclusions apply; not every tyre, towing or onward-travel cost is free. The EV terms are headed 1 September 2025 but retain an olderApril 2024 information sentence; the version is retained as published.
